params.name: transaction_ids
params.description: A list of transaction IDs to filter by

params.name: exclude_ids
params.description: A list of transaction IDs to exclude from the results

params.name: reference_id
params.description: The Reference ID of the transaction to find

params.name: type
params.description: The type of transactions to list

params.name: reversed
params.description: Whether to include reversed transactions or not

params.name: ar_entry_type
params.description: The transaction's entry type to filter by.

params.name: ar_description
params.description: The transaction's description to filter by.

params.name: invoice_number
params.description: The invoice number to filter the transactions by

params.name: search
params.description: The Reference ID of the transaction or the Invoice Number to find

params.name: invoice_id
params.description: The invoice ID to filter the transactions by

params.name: invoice_item_ids
params.description: The invoice item IDs to filter the transactions by

params.name: client_id
params.description: The client ID to filter by

params.name: funder_id
params.description: The funder ID to filter by

params.name: billing_contact_id
params.description: The billing contact ID to filter by

params.name: transaction_date_from
params.description: The date after which transactions should be filtered (inclusive) - ex. 2024-01-31

params.name: transaction_date_to
params.description: The date before which transactions should be filtered (exclusive) - ex. 2024-01-31

params.name: memo
params.description: String for which to search (partial) in the transaction memo

params.name: client_search
params.description: The name or the id of the client (partial)

params.name: date_from
params.description: The posting date after which transactions should be filtered (inclusive) - ex. 2024-01-31

params.name: date_to
params.description: The posting date before which transactions should be filtered (inclusive) - ex. 2024-01-31

params.name: account_name
params.description: The name of the account to filter by

params.name: account_number
params.description: The number of the account to filter by

params.name: account_ids
params.description: The account IDs to filter by

params.name: adjusted
params.description: Whether or not the transaction has an adjustment allocated to it.

params.name: include_medicaid
params.description: Whether or not to include medicaid funders. Defaults to True

params.name: include_ccac
params.description: Whether or not to include CCAC funders. Defaults to True

params.name: include_allocated
params.description: Whether to include allocated transactions or not

params.name: include_voided_sales
params.description: True to included voided sales; False to exclude them. Defaults to true

params.name: only_without_allocations
params.description: True to select only the transactions that do not have allocations (in this case, note that reverted allocations are considered as non-existent);  False to select the transactions no matter their number of allocations. Defaults to False.

params.name: include_canceled_payments
params.description: True to include canceled payments; False to exclude them. Defaults to true

params.name: order
params.description: Field on which to sort the results

params.name: include_account
params.description: Whether to include the account information in the response

params.name: asc
params.description: Whether to sort ascendingly, defaults to false

params.name: page
params.description: Page to retrieve

params.name: count
params.description: Number of items per page

params.name: id
params.description: Reference ID of transaction to return
